description_en: Queries the tenant-level memory configurations of the current account by agent provider, business platform, and business type
description_zh: 按 Agent 提供方、业务平台和业务类型查询当前账号的租户级记忆配置
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center get-tenant-memory-config --agent-provider OpenClaw --agent-platform ENTERPRISE --biz-type 1 --agent-instance-id '不适用（尚未启用）' --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTenantMemoryConfig

parameters.help_en: The agent provider. This parameter is used together with AgentPlatform and BizType to locate the memory configuration. You must use a configured business combination
parameters.help_zh: Agent 提供方。与 AgentPlatform、BizType 一起定位记忆配置，须使用已配置的业务组合
parameters.name: agent_provider

parameters.help_en: The business platform to which the agent belongs. Specify the platform corresponding to the tenant memory configuration, such as `ENTERPRISE` for the enterprise platform
parameters.help_zh: Agent 所属业务平台。填写与租户记忆配置对应的平台，例如企业平台 `ENTERPRISE`
parameters.name: agent_platform

parameters.help_en: The business type code. This parameter is used together with the provider and business platform. Common values include `1` for Enterprise Edition, `10` for Personal Edition, and `20` for Commercial Edition
parameters.help_zh: 业务类型编码。与提供方和业务平台一起使用。常见值包括 `1`（企业版）、`10`（个人版）、`20`（商业版）
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not enabled. Do not specify this parameter. The current API operation queries tenant configurations by provider, business platform, and business type. The example is used to illustrate the field status
parameters.help_zh: 尚未启用，请勿传入。当前接口按提供方、业务平台和业务类型查询租户配置。示例用于说明字段状态
parameters.name: agent_instance_id

schema.description_en: The response result of this API call
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

Data.description_en: The tenant memory configuration that matches the business combination
Data.description_zh: 匹配业务组合的租户记忆配置

DisabledReason.description_en: This field is not enabled. The current query result does not provide the disable reason. The example is used to illustrate the field status
DisabledReason.description_zh: 尚未启用，当前查询结果不提供关闭原因。示例用于说明字段状态

EffectiveEnabled.description_en: This field is not enabled. The current query result does not provide the effective switch of the instance
EffectiveEnabled.description_zh: 尚未启用，当前查询结果不提供实例实际生效开关

Enabled.description_en: The tenant-level memory switch for the corresponding business combination. A value of `true` indicates that the switch is enabled, and a value of `false` indicates that the switch is disabled. This field may be omitted if no switch is configured for the combination
Enabled.description_zh: 对应业务组合的租户级记忆开关。`true` 表示已启用，`false` 表示已关闭。该组合未配置开关时可能省略

InstanceDesiredEnabled.description_en: This field is not enabled. The current query result does not provide the instance desired switch
InstanceDesiredEnabled.description_zh: 尚未启用，当前查询结果不提供实例期望开关

TenantEnabled.description_en: This field is not enabled. To obtain the tenant-level configuration switch returned by the current API operation, read the Enabled field
TenantEnabled.description_zh: 尚未启用，当前接口返回的租户级配置开关请读取 Enabled

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于排查问题
